This year, however, that trade has reversed, and diversified equity ETFs are finally reaping the benefits. The Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF (ARCA: RSP) has returned 11% year-to-date. articles._summary: The European Union (EU) has accused Meta Platforms Inc. (NASDAQ: META ) of violating its digital laws due to the ‘addictive’ designs of its Instagram and Facebook platforms.
